summary: ACV Auctions Inc. filed an 8-K reporting entry into an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with Citibank, N.A. on May 12, 2026, to repurchase $50 million of its common stock under a previously announced buyback program. The company will pay $50 million on May 13, 2026, receiving an initial delivery of ~70% of the underlying shares. The final number of shares repurchased will be based on volume-weighted average price during the term, less a discount, with completion expected no later than Q4 2026. The ASR allows ACV to return capital efficiently, reducing share count and enhancing EPS. Watch for speed of execution and final share price relative to volume-weighted average price.
